name: agent-bridge
description: Launch configurable external agent CLIs from Codex and collect their task results through a local MCP bridge.

interface.shortDescription: Run configured agent CLIs and collect results
interface.longDescription: Start asynchronous tasks in locally installed agent command-line tools such as Claude Code or Antigravity CLI, then inspect bounded output, wait for completion, or cancel work. Agent aliases and launch commands are controlled by a JSON parameter file.
defaultPrompt: Use $agent-bridge to list configured agents and delegate a task.
Ask a configured external agent to review this repository.
Check the status and output of my Agent Bridge tasks.
